subject.title: [Feature]: Per-agent or per-binding session reset policy

question: What scoped reset-policy contract should OpenClaw expose for agents and route bindings, and what precedence should it have relative to channel, type, and global reset policy?
rationale: This adds public configuration surface and changes session lifecycle semantics across multi-agent routing, so automation should not choose the permanent API or precedence order alone.

options.title: Generic Binding-Scoped Policy
options.body: Add one account-aware binding or conversation-scoped reset policy that can cover Telegram groups, route bindings, and future channels without parallel precedence models.

options.title: Agent-Only Policy
options.body: Allow agents.list entries to override reset behavior, which is simpler but does not fully cover distinct workflows routed through the same agent.

options.title: No New Scoped Policy
options.body: Keep global/type/channel policy plus cron isolation as the supported model, accepting the current real-time inbound workflow limitation.

recommendation.title: Generic Binding-Scoped Policy
recommendation.body: Add one account-aware binding or conversation-scoped reset policy that can cover Telegram groups, route bindings, and future channels without parallel precedence models.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest current-main history on the reset policy helper and current reset-resolution path.
